action: kettlebell goblet squat (3 reps to kettlebell lower)
intent: Build lower-body strength with controlled squat reps while holding a kettlebell at the chest, then safely lower it to the floor.

phases.what: Standing start holding kettlebell at chest height with both hands, feet shoulder-width, initiating squat descent
First full goblet squat - descend hips back and down to bottom position then drive up to standing
Second full goblet squat repetition - same controlled down and up with kettlebell pinned to chest
Brief standing hold after last squat, maintaining posture before transitioning to lower
Hinge forward and lower kettlebell to floor with arms extended, back rounded/hinged

balance: Weight centered over mid-foot with feet flat shoulder-width apart; stability from braced core, upright torso, and kettlebell held close to chest as counterweight; even bilateral leg drive
hard_parts: Smooth eccentric-to-concentric squat transition without jerking and keeping heels down and torso upright under load, plus the final hip-hinge to floor which requires spine articulation and shifting weight forward without toppling - difficult for rigid ankles and limited hip flexion
edits: do only one slow squat with 3-second hold at bottom
squat deeper (thighs below parallel) or shallower (quarter squat)
remove weight - do bodyweight squats with hands clasped at chest
